title: Identify the names and artists of all single-faced cards that are available
question: Identify the names and artists of all single-faced cards that are available in paper format, belong to sets in either the 'Masques' or 'Mirage' block, and are legal in the Vintage format. Include only cards with non-null artist names.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_049", T1."XCL_002"
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN sets AS T2 ON T1."XCL_063" = T2."XCL_099"
INNER JOIN legalities AS T3 ON T1."XCL_072" = T3."XCL_086"
WHERE T1."XCL_004" LIKE '%paper%'
  AND T2."XCL_097" IN ('Masques', 'Mirage')
  AND T3."XCL_084" = 'vintage'
  AND T3."XCL_085" = 'Legal'
  AND T1."XCL_002" IS NOT NULL
  AND T1."XCL_037" = 'normal'
